message.content: {"component_id": "BAY-04", "confidence": "high", "contradictory_evidence_ids": [], "decision_summary": ["Solid amber LED on BAY-04 verified by pixel analysis and vision model, not assumed from report alone.", "Manual LED rule confirms solid amber = predictive failure / unrecoverable threshold breach requiring replacement, distinct from blinking amber rebuild.", "Telemetry shows definitive physical failure: predictive failure flagged, reallocated sectors 164 with progression from 48, unrecovered read errors.", "Controller logs independently assert SMART predictive failure and enable amber fault indicator on BAY-04.", "RAID rebuild activity excluded as cause: rebuild is on BAY-02 with blinking amber, per logs and RAID manual."], "device_id": "SRV-004", "incident_id": "INC-SRV-004-BAY-04-AMBER", "missing_information": "None - failure corroborated by reallocated sectors plus unrecovered medium errors and controller predictive-failure assertion; no additional discriminating surface scan required as pending sectors are accompanied by reallocated sectors.", "reasoning": "Technician reported solid amber on SRV-004 BAY-04. Visual evidence EV-IMG-SRV004_BAY04_AMBER_SOLID and VISION confirm amber LED on SRV-004/BAY-04. MAN-LED-01 defines solid amber as predictive failure warning or unrecoverable hardware threshold breach with exceeded spare reallocation or uncorrected read errors requiring replacement, while blinking amber is RAID rebuild. Telemetry EV-TEL-SRV004-BAY04-S2 shows SMART failing, predictive_failure true, reallocated_sectors 164, pending 45, read_error_rate 1820, RAID degraded, with progression from S1 (48/12/310, degraded/optimal). Logs corroborate: EV-LOG-SRV004-0011 SMART reallocated threshold crossed at 48, EV-LOG-SRV004-0012 SCSI Medium Error ASC 0x11 ASCQ 0x00 unrecovered read error, EV-LOG-SRV004-0013 CRITICAL predictive failure asserted on BAY-04 with amber fault enabled. Rebuild explanation refuted: EV-LOG-SRV004-0014 shows resync on BAY-02 with blinking amber, and MAN-RAID-01 confirms blinking amber is rebuild state. Temperature 49C below MAN-ERR-03 55C threshold.
